name: Multi-frame rendering (MFR)
notes: maxCpuUsagePercentage is deliberately 50, not the submitter's default of 90: at 90 the asserted value is indistinguishable from the default, so the case proved nothing about the setting propagating. test_job_settings now checks MultiFrameRendering=ON and MaxCpuUsagePercentage=50 in the bundle.
